measurement_columns: aggregate tokens saved for exact-wire equality else zero
mapping: left/right.reshape(400,2,12)[train/tune questions]; receiver=4+destination in source-major 4-node off-diagonal edges; aggregate=8; seed execution=2701+index
baseline_definition: Logical full baseline graph token sum over all 9 nodes, once per distinct (left graph index, seed). This is a declared accounting model using recorded tokens, not reconstructed actual physical GPU or call cost. Additional identical prompt/node caching is not inferred from missing call_id/reused metadata.
overlap_audit: Report right graph membership in left bank. Physical graph reuse could change action space; the logical-observation ledger charges purchased counterfactual completion even if physically cached, matching the autonomy contract. Do not interpret this logical cost as actual physical execution cost.
complete_cost_variants: All distinct left baselines prepaid: B + suffix cost
Lazy baseline activation: expected touched (left graph, seed) baseline costs for the selected receiver probes
lazy_cost: SRS group-touch probability 1-C(N-m,n)/C(N,n); Bernoulli probe group-touch probability 1-(1-q)^m. Continuous gamma extension for SRS n is explicitly a relaxation.
scoring_sensitivity: Historical scoring wall time is unknown. Add hypothetical per-score token-equivalent cost 0,0.1,1.0 times the split mean aggregate input+output tokens; pay once for each baseline score and each purchased noncoalesced aggregate score. Zero is optimistic, not measured free scoring.
assumed_ratio_sensitivity: Receiver/aggregate unit cost 0.5,1,2 uses hypothetical constant costs and suffix-only budgets. Keep these separate from observed heterogeneous token counts; complete baseline costs are measured-token logical scenarios only.
scope_guard: Do not read quality_by_seed, masks or raw node content: rows already contain authorized credits. D2 mapping metadata only, with partition filter before outcome calculations.
nonclaims: shared physical cache ignored in deployment
